phrases.text: for what it's worth 不论真伪
phrases.meaningZh: for what it's worth 不论真伪

cards.example: This old phone is worthless because the screen is broken.
cards.exampleZh: 这部旧手机因为没有价值，因为屏幕坏了。

cards.example: It is worthwhile to spend time with your family every day.
cards.exampleZh: 每天花时间陪伴家人是值得的。

phrases.text: a worthwhile cause 值得为之奋斗的事业
phrases.meaningZh: a worthwhile cause 值得为之奋斗的事业

senses.meaningZh: 值得的；配得上的；可敬的

cards.example: She is a worthy teacher who always helps her students with patience.
cards.exampleZh: 她是一位值得尊敬的好老师，总是耐心地帮助学生。

cards.example: I would like a cup of tea, please.
cards.exampleZh: 我想要一杯茶。

cards.example: The nurse cleaned the wound on his leg and put a bandage on it.
cards.exampleZh: 护士清洗了他腿上的伤口，并给它缠上了绷带。

cards.example: The two brothers wrangle over money every time they meet.
cards.exampleZh: 两兄弟每次见面都会为钱争吵。

cards.example: She wrapped the gift in bright paper before giving it to him.
cards.exampleZh: 她把礼物用亮色的纸包好，然后才送给他。

cards.example: The teacher gave a short wrap-up at the end of the class.
cards.exampleZh: 老师在课程结束时做了一个简短的总结。

cards.example: His face turned red with wrath when he saw the broken window.
cards.exampleZh: 当他看到破碎的窗户时，他气得脸都红了。

phrases.text: the wrath of God 上帝的震怒
phrases.meaningZh: the wrath of God 上帝的震怒

cards.example: She laid a wreath of white flowers on the old stone grave.
cards.exampleZh: 她在古老的石墓上放了一个白花花圈。

cards.example: The storm wrecked the small boat near the rocks, but all the sailors were safe.
cards.exampleZh: 风暴在岩石附近毁坏了那艘小船，但所有水手都安然无恙。

phrases.text: Nervous wreck 精神崩溃的人
phrases.meaningZh: Nervous wreck 精神崩溃的人

cards.example: He used a wrench to turn the rusty bolt, then wrenched his back.
cards.exampleZh: 他用扳手转动生锈的螺栓，然后扭伤了背。

phrases.text: throw a wrench into 阻碍
phrases.meaningZh: throw a wrench into 阻碍

cards.example: The police had to wrest the knife from his hand.
cards.exampleZh: 警察不得不从他手中夺下那把刀。

phrases.text: wreak/wrest control from 从……夺取控制权

cards.example: The two boys began to wrestle on the grass after school.
cards.exampleZh: 放学后，两个男孩开始在草地上摔跤。

cards.example: My brother likes wrestling and watches it on TV every weekend.
cards.exampleZh: 我哥哥喜欢摔跤，每个周末都在电视上看。

cards.example: The poor wretch had no home and slept in the cold street.
cards.exampleZh: 那个可怜的人没有家，睡在寒冷的街上。

cards.example: The poor family lived in a wretched little house without clean water.
cards.exampleZh: 这户穷苦人家住在一间没有干净水的破旧小屋里。

cards.example: The little fish wriggled in my hands and then fell back into the water.
cards.exampleZh: 那条小鱼在我手里扭动着，随后又掉回了水里。

cards.example: She had to wring the wet towel before hanging it up.
cards.exampleZh: 她得先把湿毛巾拧干，然后再挂起来。

phrases.text: wring one's hands 搓手（焦急）
phrases.meaningZh: wring one's hands 搓手（焦急）

cards.example: There is a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
cards.exampleZh: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。

cards.example: She hurt her wrist when she fell off her bike yesterday.
cards.exampleZh: 她昨天从自行车上摔下来时伤到了手腕。

cards.example: I write a short letter to my mother every week.
cards.exampleZh: 我每周给妈妈写一封短信。

cards.example: She wrote a short write-up about the school concert for the local newspaper.
cards.exampleZh: 她为当地报纸写了一篇关于学校音乐会的简短报道。

cards.example: Her writing is clear and easy to read.
cards.exampleZh: 她的写作清晰易懂。

cards.example: It is wrong to take things that are not yours.
cards.exampleZh: 拿走不属于自己的东西是不道德的。

cards.example: The company denied any wrongdoing and said it would fight the case in court.
cards.exampleZh: 公司否认有任何不道德行为，并表示将在法庭上抗辩此案。

phrases.text: alleged wrongdoing 被指控的不法行为
phrases.meaningZh: alleged wrongdoing 被指控的不法行为

cards.example: The wrought iron gate looked old but very strong.
cards.exampleZh: 那扇锻铁大门看起来很旧，但非常坚固。

cards.example: On the graph, time is shown on the x-axis from left to right.
cards.exampleZh: 在图表上，时间从左到右显示在X轴上。

cards.example: The doctor took an x-ray of my arm to see the broken bone.
cards.exampleZh: 医生给我的手臂拍了一张X光片，看看骨折的情况。

cards.example: The bright blue light in the sign comes from xenon gas.
cards.exampleZh: 招牌里明亮的蓝光来自氙气。

cards.example: Xenophobia can make people treat newcomers unfairly.
cards.exampleZh: 排外心理会让人们不公平地对待新来的人。

cards.example: The office bought a new xerographic machine to copy documents quickly.
cards.exampleZh: 办公室买了一台新的静电复印机，用来快速复印文件。

cards.example: A cactus is a xerophyte that stores water in its thick stem.
cards.exampleZh: 仙人掌是一种旱生植物，把水储存在粗厚的茎里。

cards.example: Water moves up through the xylem of the plant stem.
cards.exampleZh: 水分通过植物茎的木质部向上运输。

cards.example: My little sister can play a short song on the wooden xylophone.
cards.exampleZh: 我妹妹能用木琴演奏一首短曲。

cards.example: They rented a small yacht and sailed along the coast for a week.
cards.exampleZh: 他们租了一艘小游艇，沿着海岸航行了一个星期。

cards.example: My mother cooked yam soup with some pork for dinner.
cards.exampleZh: 我妈妈晚饭做了山药排骨汤。

cards.example: He yanked the door open and ran out into the street.
cards.exampleZh: 他猛地把门拉开，跑到了街上。

cards.example: Our dog likes to run around the yard after dinner.
cards.exampleZh: 我们的狗喜欢在晚饭后在院子里跑来跑去。

cards.example: The test score is a useful yardstick for measuring student progress.
cards.exampleZh: 考试分数是衡量学生进步的有用标准。

phrases.text: a yardstick for 衡量……的标准
phrases.meaningZh: a yardstick for 衡量……的标准

cards.example: Grandma told us a funny yarn about her old village school.
cards.exampleZh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个关于她村里旧学校的有趣故事。

cards.example: The old woman picked some yarrow in the field to make tea.
cards.exampleZh: 那位老妇人在田野里采了一些蓍草用来泡茶。

cards.example: My sister will start college next year in a new city.
cards.exampleZh: 我妹妹明年将在一座新城市开始上大学。

cards.example: The farmer kept the yearling in a small field near the barn.
cards.exampleZh: 农夫把那只一岁幼兽养在谷仓附近的一小块地里。

cards.example: I yearn to see my old friends again after so many years.
cards.exampleZh: 这么多年过去了，我渴望再次见到我的老朋友们。

cards.example: She felt a deep yearning for her home in the mountains.
cards.exampleZh: 她对山里的家乡有着深深的向往。

cards.example: Yeast makes the bread rise and become soft.
cards.exampleZh: 酵母使面包发酵膨胀并变得松软。

cards.example: The coach began to yell at the players when they missed the ball.
cards.exampleZh: 当球员们没接到球时，教练开始对他们大喊大叫。

cards.example: She is wearing a bright yellow dress to the party today.
cards.exampleZh: 她今天穿着一件鲜黄色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

cards.example: The dog yelped when I stepped on its tail by accident.
cards.exampleZh: 我不小心踩到它的尾巴时，那只狗尖叫了一声。

cards.example: Yes, I want to go with you to the park today.
cards.exampleZh: 是的，我今天想和你一起去公园。

cards.example: I saw my old friend at the park yesterday.
cards.exampleZh: 我昨天在公园里见到了我的老朋友。

cards.example: In the quiet village, people still sing the songs of yesteryear.
cards.exampleZh: 在这个安静的村庄里，人们仍然唱着往昔的歌曲。

cards.example: The bus has not arrived yet, so we must wait here.
cards.exampleZh: 公交车还没有到，所以我们必须在这里等。

cards.example: The old yew in our garden is tall and very green.
cards.exampleZh: 我们花园里的那棵老紫杉又高又非常绿。

senses.meaningZh: 出产；屈服；让路；产量；收益

cards.example: The farm yields enough corn to feed all the animals.
cards.exampleZh: 这个农场出产的玉米足够喂养所有动物。

cards.example: The ox wears a heavy wooden yoke around its neck.
cards.exampleZh: 那头牛的脖子上套着一副沉重的木轭。

phrases.text: under the yoke of 受……束缚
phrases.meaningZh: under the yoke of 受……束缚

cards.example: The yolk of a boiled egg is bright yellow and tastes very good.
cards.exampleZh: 水煮蛋的蛋黄是亮黄色的，味道非常好。

cards.example: The old house yonder looks quiet in the evening light.
cards.exampleZh: 远处的那座老房子在暮色中显得很安静。

cards.example: Can you help me carry these books to the classroom?
cards.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些书搬到教室吗？

cards.example: My young sister likes to play in the park after school.
cards.exampleZh: 我年幼的妹妹喜欢放学后去公园玩。

cards.example: The youngster across the street plays basketball with his friends every Saturday morning.
cards.exampleZh: 街对面的那个少年每周六早上都和朋友们一起打篮球。

cards.example: Please put your books on the desk before the class starts.
cards.exampleZh: 上课前请把你的书放在桌子上。

cards.example: My grandfather often talks about the happy days of his youth.
cards.exampleZh: 我祖父经常谈起他青年时期的快乐时光。

cards.example: The cake you made is really yummy and everyone wants more.
cards.exampleZh: 你做的蛋糕真好吃，大家都想再来一些。

cards.example: His zany jokes made everyone laugh during the long meeting.
cards.exampleZh: 在漫长的会议中，他那些滑稽的笑话让每个人都笑了。

cards.example: Her zeal for teaching made every class lively and full of joy.
cards.exampleZh: 她对教学的热情让每堂课都生动而充满乐趣。

cards.example: The zealot talked about his idea all day and never listened to others.
cards.exampleZh: 那个狂热者整天谈论他的想法，从不听别人的话。

cards.example: He is a zealous worker who always helps his friends.
cards.exampleZh: 他是一个总是帮助朋友的热心工作者。

cards.example: We saw a zebra with black and white stripes at the zoo.
cards.exampleZh: 我们在动物园看到了一只黑白条纹的斑马。

cards.example: The sun was directly overhead at the zenith of the sky.
cards.exampleZh: 太阳正好位于天空的天顶处。

phrases.text: at the zenith of 在……的顶峰
phrases.meaningZh: at the zenith of 在……的顶峰

cards.example: The temperature dropped to zero last night and the lake froze.
cards.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到零度，湖面结冰了。

cards.example: She added lemon zest to the cake and ate it with great zest.
cards.exampleZh: 她往蛋糕里加了柠檬皮屑，然后兴致勃勃地吃了它。

phrases.text: zest for life 生活热情
phrases.meaningZh: zest for life 生活热情

cards.example: The narrow road zigzags up the mountain behind our small village.
cards.exampleZh: 那条狭窄的小路在我们小村庄后面的山上蜿蜒而上。

cards.example: This old gate is made of zinc so it will not rust.
cards.exampleZh: 这扇旧门是用锌做的，所以不会生锈。

senses.meaningZh: 拉链；活力；拉开；快速移动

cards.example: He zipped up his jacket and ran to catch the bus.
cards.exampleZh: 他拉上夹克拉链，跑去赶公交车。

cards.example: This area is a quiet zone where cars are not allowed.
cards.exampleZh: 这个区域是一个安静的禁行区，汽车不允许进入。

cards.example: My little brother loves to see the pandas at the zoo.
cards.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜欢去动物园看熊猫。

cards.example: Prices zoomed up fast after the good news.
cards.exampleZh: 好消息传来后，价格迅速飙升。
